summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal and returning a bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title) for the title control; CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run (per instructions), so verification is by reading only. No commits made.
